page.notes: Marginal notes on the right are reconstructed from the small type: "Principium" at the top of the activum/passivum block is read as "Pricinpium" on the scan and is doubtful; "QUO." and "QUOD." are read as printed. Greek word ἐλλειπτικῶς is doubtful in its accents. The word "Me-diis" is set in italic and its last syllable is doubtful. The Latin "funt", "eft" and "fi" forms are normalised to sunt, est and si per the long-s rule. The line "Schola Naturæ continet..." is treated as a running paragraph.
